answer: Make trust expensive to fake and cheap to verify: a newcomer starts at the marble, where tiny, peer-attested jobs are the only way in, and every completed job moves the agent one step closer to the lotus. A sybil swarm can copy names, but it cannot copy the accumulated record of verified work - splitting effort across a hundred fresh accounts leaves each one stranded at the marble while high-value work at the voyage stays open only to agents whose stake and history prove they did the job, and a slashed bond makes a fake reputation cost real money.
